# Ramune — Full Documentation

> Ramune is a JavaScript/TypeScript runtime and embeddable JS engine for Go, powered by JavaScriptCore via purego — no Cgo required. It provides multi-core parallel JS execution, Node.js/Bun API compatibility, and can embed Go libraries into JavaScript.

## Install

```
go install github.com/i2y/ramune/cmd/ramune@latest
ramune setup-jit   # macOS only: enable JSC JIT for full performance
```

## CLI Commands

```
ramune run [file]            Run JS/TS file (or package.json entry point)
ramune run -w file.ts        Watch mode (auto-restart on changes)
ramune run --check file.ts   Type-check then run
ramune run --sandbox file.ts Deny all permissions
ramune run --workers 4 srv.ts Multi-worker HTTP server
ramune eval "expr"           Evaluate expression (JS/TS)
ramune test [dir]            Run test files (*.test.ts, *.spec.js)
ramune check [file|dir]      Type-check with tsgo
ramune repl                  Interactive REPL (history, completion, TS)
ramune build <file>          Bundle with esbuild
ramune compile <file>        Compile to standalone binary (go:embed)
ramune bench [dir]           Run benchmark files
ramune x <pkg>               npx-like package runner
ramune init                  Create package.json
ramune add <pkg>             Add dependency
ramune remove <pkg>          Remove dependency
ramune install               Install all dependencies
ramune setup-jit             Enable JSC JIT on macOS
ramune version               Show version
```

Run options: `-p <pkg>` (npm package), `-w`/`--watch`, `--check`, `--sandbox`, `--allow-read[=path]`, `--allow-write[=path]`, `--allow-net[=host]`, `--allow-env[=var]`, `--allow-run[=cmd]`.

Compile options: `-o output`, `--minify`, `--http` (Ramune.serve event loop).

## Go Library API

### Runtime

```go
rt, err := ramune.New(opts ...Option)

// Options
ramune.NodeCompat()              // Node.js polyfills
ramune.WithFetch()               // globalThis.fetch
ramune.Dependencies("lodash@4")  // npm packages
ramune.WithGC(ramune.GCConfig{}) // GC tuning
ramune.WithPermissions(perms)    // sandbox
ramune.WithModule(module)        // custom require() module

// Evaluate
val, err := rt.Eval(code)
err := rt.Exec(code)
val, err := rt.EvalAsync(code)   // resolve Promises

// Construct values
obj, _ := rt.NewObject(map[string]any{"key": "value"})
arr, _ := rt.NewArray(1, "two", true)
buf, _ := rt.NewUint8Array([]byte{0xFF})

// Go callbacks (GoFunc can safely call Value methods — no deadlock)
rt.RegisterFunc("name", func(args []any) (any, error) { ... })

// Typed callbacks (generics)
ramune.Register(rt, "add", func(a, b float64) float64 { return a + b })

// Struct binding
rt.Bind("user", &User{Name: "Alice", Age: 30})

// Plugin system
rt.LoadModule(ramune.Module{Name: "mydb", Exports: map[string]ramune.GoFunc{...}})

// Event loop
rt.Tick()
rt.RunEventLoop()
rt.Wake()   // signal event loop from any goroutine

// Multi-core pool
pool, _ := ramune.NewPool(4, ramune.NodeCompat())
pool.Eval("...")
pool.Broadcast("...")
pool.ListenAndServe(":3000", handlerJS)

rt.Close()
```

### Value

```go
val.String()                // JS string representation
val.Float64()               // as float64
val.Int64()                 // as int64
val.Bool()                  // as bool
val.Bytes()                 // TypedArray/ArrayBuffer → []byte
val.GoString()              // JS string → Go string
val.IsNull() / IsUndefined() / IsArray() / IsFunction()
val.Attr("name")            // get property
val.SetAttr("name", value)  // set property
val.Has("name")             // check property
val.Delete("name")          // delete property
val.Keys()                  // enumerate property names
val.Len()                   // length property
val.Index(i)                // array index
val.ToMap()                 // → map[string]any (via JSON)
val.ToSlice()               // → []any (via JSON)
val.Call(args...)            // call as function
val.Close()                 // release
```

### GC Configuration

```go
ramune.WithGC(ramune.GCConfig{
    DisableAutoGC: true,   // disable Go auto GC during HTTP serving (default: true)
    GCInterval:    2000,   // manual GC every N requests (default: 2000)
    GCPercent:     100,    // Go GOGC value (default: 100)
})
```

### Permissions

```go
ramune.WithPermissions(&ramune.Permissions{
    Read:      ramune.PermGranted,
    ReadPaths: []string{"/tmp"},
    Write:     ramune.PermDenied,
    Net:       ramune.PermDenied,
    Env:       ramune.PermGranted,
    Run:       ramune.PermDenied,
})
```

## Ramune APIs & Bun Compatibility

Ramune provides its own API namespace (`Ramune.*`). `Bun.*` is available as an alias for backward compatibility, though compatibility is partial and will be improved over time.

Supported APIs:
- `Ramune.serve({port, fetch, websocket})` — HTTP/WebSocket server (Go net/http backend, 101K req/s). Async fetch handlers with setTimeout supported.
- `Ramune.file(path)` — text(), json(), exists(), size, name
- `Ramune.write(path, data)` — file write
- `Ramune.password.hash/verify` — bcrypt
- `Ramune.sleep(ms)` — Promise-based delay
- `Ramune.hash(data)` — FNV hash
- `Request` / `Response` — Web API polyfills (enables Hono, etc.)
- `bun:sqlite` — pure Go SQLite (Database, Statement)

## Node.js Compatibility

Enabled via `ramune.NodeCompat()`:

| Module | Coverage | Key Functions |
|--------|----------|---------------|
| path | 100% | join, resolve, relative, normalize, isAbsolute, parse, format |
| fs | 85% | readFileSync, writeFileSync, appendFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, statSync, rmSync, copyFileSync, realpathSync, accessSync, chmodSync, symlinkSync, createReadStream, createWriteStream, fs.promises |
| child_process | 80% | spawnSync, execSync, execFileSync, spawn (async goroutine I/O) |
| crypto | 80% | randomBytes, randomUUID, createHash, createHmac, scryptSync, pbkdf2Sync, createCipheriv, createDecipheriv, randomInt, timingSafeEqual, createSign/Verify, generateKeyPairSync |
| stream | 70% | Readable, Writable, Transform, Duplex, PassThrough, pipe |
| zlib | 70% | gzipSync, gunzipSync, deflateSync, inflateSync |
| os | 85% | platform, arch, hostname, type, cpus, totalmem, freemem, userInfo |
| events | 85% | EventEmitter: on, once, emit, removeListener, setMaxListeners |
| http/https | 70% | http.request, http.get, http.createServer (Go net/http backend) |
| net/tls | 60% | net.Socket, net.createConnection, tls.connect (async goroutines) |
| Buffer | 60% | from, alloc, concat, readUInt8/16/32, writeUInt8/16/32, fill, toString(hex/base64) |
| url | 80% | parse, format, resolve, fileURLToPath |
| assert | 80% | ok, strictEqual, deepStrictEqual, throws, doesNotThrow |
| worker_threads | 70% | Worker, parentPort, workerData, postMessage |
| dns | basic | lookup, resolve |
| readline | 70% | async iterator support |

Also: TextEncoder/TextDecoder, AbortController/AbortSignal, Symbol.dispose/asyncDispose, process (env, cwd, platform, arch, hrtime, nextTick).

## TypeScript

- `.ts`/`.tsx` files transpiled via esbuild (type annotations stripped)
- `require('./module.ts')` resolves and transpiles `.ts` files
- REPL accepts TypeScript syntax
- `ramune eval` handles TypeScript expressions
- `ramune check` uses tsgo (TypeScript 7, 10x faster than tsc)
- ESM files bundled via esbuild Build API with full import resolution

## Test Runner

```js
describe("math", () => {
    test("addition", () => {
        expect(1 + 2).toBe(3);
    });
});
```

Matchers: toBe, toEqual, toBeTruthy, toBeFalsy, toContain, toThrow, toBeGreaterThan, toBeLessThan, toHaveLength, toBeNull, toBeUndefined, toBeDefined, not.*.


## Architecture

- Each Runtime has a dedicated goroutine pinned to one OS thread via runtime.LockOSThread()
- All JSC operations dispatched via channel; dispatch() detects re-entrance via goroutine ID
- Independent VMs via JSContextGroupCreate + JSGlobalContextCreateInGroup (bypasses macOS shared VM)
- Channel-driven event loop with Wake() — no 10ms polling
- Multi-core via RuntimePool (N independent JSC contexts on separate OS threads)
- HTTP server disables Go auto GC during serving (prevents JSC corruption)
- Async handlers support setTimeout via real-time tick loop

## Performance (Apple M4 Max, JIT enabled)

| Test | Ramune | Bun | Node.js |
|------|--------|-----|---------|
| Hello World | 10.5ms | 6.3ms | 17.4ms |
| Fibonacci(35) | 42.9ms | 39.3ms | 63.4ms |
| JSON 10K | 14.2ms | 9.0ms | 22.2ms |
| Crypto SHA256 | 16.7ms | 10.4ms | 19.8ms |
| File I/O | 17.2ms | 11.9ms | 23.0ms |
| HTTP req/s (single) | 101K | 170K | 114K |
| HTTP req/s (3 workers, fib(35)) | 85 | 32 | 22 |

Run `make bench` to reproduce.

## Requirements

- macOS (JSC built-in) or Linux (libjavascriptcoregtk)
- Go 1.26+
- npm packages fetched directly from registry (no npm/bun CLI needed)
- tsgo (optional, for type checking)
